summary: Completed BOTH backend and frontend regression for student/enterprise courses + AI agents navigation and detail flows on the public preview URL. Backend smoke APIs passed (4/4). Frontend core flows passed (nav updates, six-course catalogues, coming-soon behavior, enterprise B2B detail content, enquiry context capture via TEST-ONLY interception, responsive overflow matrix, /enterprise/programme reachability).

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent React console error observed: duplicate children key for course id `5f69ef74-9bff-4cb7-9b5d-68a82d9aad5c` during catalogue navigation runs.

action_items: Investigate and remove the intermittent duplicate React key warning in catalogue rendering.
Optionally add deterministic test hooks for forcing first-call catalogue/curriculum failures to make retry-state automation stable.
critical_code_review_comments: `CourseDetailsPage.jsx` is very large (>1400 lines) and should be split into smaller modules for maintainability and safer regression scope.
Verified frontend API base usage is env-based (`process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL`) in enterprise API calls.
No hardcoded localhost/internal URLs found in tested student/enterprise catalogue + AI-agent flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with public URL from frontend/.env. Confirmed nav additions: student `/courses` + `/ai-agents`, enterprise `/enterprise/courses` + `/enterprise/ai-agents`; no Programme/Programmer nav links while `/enterprise/programme` remains reachable. Verified six cards in both catalogues, coming-soon routing, live student detail presence (`detail-hero`), enterprise detail B2B sections/no student enroll CTA, unknown enterprise-id not-found state, enquiry form native validation and TEST-ONLY intercepted submit body containing `Course: ...` context (no real lead creation), responsive overflow checks at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 (no horizontal overflow), and student theme toggle visibility/clickability. Audience gateway modal can appear asynchronously on first-visit flows; tests should explicitly resolve it before checking nav interactions.
rca of the issue: Duplicate-key warning likely originates from catalogue card rendering keyed by course id when multiple render paths race during audience-gate/route transitions; reproduce by repeated fast navigation among /courses, /ai-agents, and enterprise routes while catalog fetches are in-flight. Mitigation: audit list rendering paths to ensure a single sibling list per key-space and no temporary duplicated arrays in state transitions.
